scores.tell: Barely any; the pure cyan keys are slightly synthetic. Tilted floating hero on a tone-on-tone pattern, like the real whistle card.
The rope's yellow is a little uniform, with muted shadow color. Otherwise a clean, quiet wave backdrop like the real towel card.
Uniformly polished gold with sharp white hot spots on the ball tips, slightly toy-like.
The truss crops off both edges and the extra light beams add a bit of clutter. Metal finish and chroma are close to real.
Busy background with buildings, hedge and path; the orange roof merges with the tree trunk. The scene approach itself matches the real swing card.
Plank floor plus striped wall staging and a glossy navy tube with a hard specular streak. Close to the graded-2/3 barrel lessons.
Swollen, clay-like coral with uniform wet gloss and pinpoint highlights, at full neon chroma. Leans toward the too-glossy and too-round lessons.
A wide pier-and-sea landscape with no central hero, photoreal water caustics and dense edges across the whole frame.
A beach scene with many whimsical props (starfish, shell, ball, palm, cow logo) and lacquered high gloss on everything; the hero is not isolated.
Two competing heroes (target and teddy) in a cluttered marquee-light shelf frame, with too many loud hue families.
